name: APPEAL_GRV_REC_STAT_HX
description: This table contains information about changes to the Chronicles record status/soft-delete flag (SDFL item) of the appeal/grievance record. Only records that have had their record status changed will be included in this table.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CM_PHY_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this record or line. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: SDFL_EDIT_INSTANT_DTTM
columns.description: Stores the instant that the record status was changed

columns.name: SDFL_EDIT_USER_ID
columns.description: Stores the user who changed the record status

columns.name: SDFL_EDIT_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: SDFL_EDIT_ACTI_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the action that was applied to the record status
